dogecoin.text: @DougPolkPoker Lol! If you think #verge is a #dogecoin fork, you’ve already lost this argument. Seems to me, all of these #cryptotwitter “OGs” are exactly that: old grandparents.

@CryptoXperts @XVGcabrasm @AshmanCrago @xvgninja @coinbase @vergecurrency @Pornhub @xvgmarketingeu @CryptoRekt Lol that’s where you’re wrong. It never forked from $doge. Again, try to suppress your troll rage and keep up with reality.
